name: GenAI-Bench
intro: GenAI-Bench 是从 GenAI-Arena 社区投票中清洗得到的多模态偏好基准，用于衡量 MLLM 裁判能否在图像生成、图像编辑和视频生成任务上复现人类四分类偏好。它与另一个含1,600条组合式提示词的同名文生视觉基准不同。
build_method: 匿名社区投票, NSFW清洗, 专家抽样复核
modality: 图像, 视频, 文本
task_type: 多模态裁判, 偏好评测
eval_feature: 四分类偏好, 精确匹配, 社区投票
build_method_en: Anonymous Community Voting, NSFW Filtering, Expert Sample Review
eval_feature_en: Four-way Preference Labels, Exact Match, Community Votes
intro_en: GenAI-Bench is a multimodal preference benchmark cleaned from GenAI-Arena community votes. It measures whether MLLM judges reproduce human four-way preferences across image generation, image editing, and video generation. It is distinct from the separate 1,600-prompt compositional text-to-visual benchmark with the same name.
scale_en: 3,723 preference pairs (1,735 image generation; 919 editing; 1,069 video)

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2406.04485v4, official repository revision f0b0334d414074c6b1c97e2c60ad8d8a592bda9f, and official Hugging Face dataset revision 7981a194091d2201447f0c0e9cc4261dd5ad5846. This entry is the GenAI-Arena preference benchmark, not the separate 1,600-prompt compositional GenAI-Bench. The Arena integrates 35 open models for image generation, image editing, and video generation, mixing live prompts with ImagenHub/VBench and precomputed GenAI-Museum outputs. It anonymously presents same-task pairs and collects left-better, right-better, tie-good, or both-bad votes; votes are discarded if identities are revealed. Llama Guard and technical filtering precede release. The expert audit samples 350 votes: 303 valid, 17 NSFW, and 30 technical failures; among valid votes, 231 are clearly reasonable, 51 vague, and 21 wrong, so 93.07% are clearly or vaguely reasonable. GenAI-Bench v1 is the test_v1 split loaded by the pinned official code: 1,735 image-generation + 919 editing + 1,069 video pairs = 3,723. The same pinned dataset revision also exposes a later test split with 3,192 + 983 + 1,911 = 6,086 pairs; these versions must not merge. Task-specific judge prompts cover prompt following, naturalness, artifacts, aesthetics, editing-instruction compliance and overediting, plus video visual quality, temporal coherence, and dynamism. Video input uses at most 8 frames; video-capable models receive native video, while other MLLMs receive sampled frames. The parser takes the first greedy [[.*]] match and accepts [[A>>B]]/[[A>B]], [[B>>A]]/[[B>A]], [[A=B]]/[[A=B=Good]] for ties, and [[A=B]]/[[A=B=Bad]] for both-bad. The metric is mean boolean agreement per task and an unweighted three-task average. Arena Bradley–Terry ratings rank generators and are separate from GenAI-Bench judge accuracy.
